headline: High school consolidation application, Portland Administrators Association contract, and middle school design update.
summary: The meeting will consider an application for school consolidation to submit to the State Department of Education. It will also cover a contract with the Portland Administrators Association, a middle school design update, and several reports.
items: Public comment on items not on the agenda
Review of personnel items: resignations, terminations, position shifts, and other hires
Finance, Personnel and Operations Committee report
Curriculum and Student Success Committee report
Public and Legislative Affairs Committee report
Briefing on the Elementary Network Team
Foundation for Portland Public Schools quarter one report
Second reading and resolution to submit the Application for School Consolidation to the State Department of Education
Adoption of the collective bargaining agreement with the Portland Administrators Association (PAA)
Executive session to discuss contract negotiations with the Portland Administrators Association under 1 M.R.S.A. § 405(6)(D)
location: In-person at Casco Bay High School and via Zoom (https://tinyurl.com/3c3tayaj)
